sn46.40:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhiyā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:1.3: kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ bhikkhave andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhiyaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ.
sn46.40:1.7: vicikicchānīvaraṇaṃ bhikkhave andhakaraṇaṃ acakkhukaraṇaṃ aññāṇakaraṇaṃ paññānirodhiyaṃ vighātapakkhiyaṃ anibbānasaṃvattanikaṃ.
sn46.40:1.8: ime bhikkhave pañca nīvaraṇā andhakaraṇā acakkhukaraṇā aññāṇakaraṇā paññānirodhiyā vighātapakkhiyā anibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:2.1: sattime bhikkhave bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuḍḍhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikā.
sn46.40:2.3: satisambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuḍḍhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko. pe. upekkhāsambojjhaṅgo bhikkhave cakkhukaraṇo ñāṇakaraṇo paññāvuḍḍhiyo avighātapakkhiyo nibbānasaṃvattaniko.
sn46.40:2.4: ime kho bhikkhave satta bojjhaṅgā cakkhukaraṇā ñāṇakaraṇā paññāvuḍḍhiyā avighātapakkhiyā nibbānasaṃvattanikāti.
